title: Choose a safer look
question: You asked for a quieter hand. These three come from school paper and the print desk. The last card is a normal admin app, set next to cardPresso, a university portal, and a typical ID-badge tool. Pick one, or roll again.

options.label: The Fiche
options.lineage: School carbon-copy form: white, pink, yellow, a stamp you cannot un-ink
options.thesis: A Request is one school fiche. Draft has no stamp. Send locks it. A no comes back on the same sheet with a written reason.
options.viewport: On a phone, one fiche fills the screen: Photo in the corner box, details in numbered lines, Send Request as the stamp at the bottom.
options.risk: Can feel like a tax form if the boxes get too dense for a phone.

options.label: The Gazette
options.lineage: Cameroon official notice: republic header, black ink on pale stock
options.thesis: Every screen is an official notice of the Request. Status is the headline. The next step is the only action.
options.viewport: A short official heading, then the one status in large type: draft, sent, come collect. One action under it.
options.risk: Can feel like a ministry site, not a school desk, if the header gets bigger than the job.

options.label: The Print Desk
options.lineage: Evolis desk: crop marks, credit-card plate, fluorescent gray
options.thesis: The card plate is always in view. A Request is a plate in a slot. Print is the same plate, actual size.
options.viewport: A credit-card plate sits in crop marks. Status is the label on the slot. Send or Print is the only big control under it.
options.risk: Students on a phone do not sit at the Evolis. The plate can hide the form if it stays huge.

canonCard.label: A normal school admin app
canonCard.thesis: Sidebar, table of Requests, blue buttons. The craft bar is cardPresso, a university self-service portal, and a typical ID-badge tool — done clean, not copied.
canonCard.viewport: A side list of Open Requests. Open a row. Accept or turn down on the right.
canonCard.risk: Looks like those tools on purpose.
